title: Tobacco Industry System Components
description: An interactive network diagram showing the interconnected stakeholders and dynamics of the tobacco industry as a complex system, including money flows, influence, products, and regulatory relationships.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Systems Thinking, Ethics, Public Health
learningObjective: Students will understand how to identify system components and map their interconnections
learningObjectives: Understand the key concepts of tobacco industry system components
Explore tobacco industry system components through interactive visualization
Apply knowledge of tobacco industry system components to solve problems
Experiment with parameters to observe their effects on tobacco industry system components
